turns.text: That's fantastic news. It's always a relief when a back injury is fully behind you. Do you and Grace have any big plans for the evening?

turns.text: Nothing too crazy. We're just going to unwind, order some food, and watch some sitcom reruns tonight.

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: Yes, exactly! We found a bunch of old sitcom reruns on there, so we're going to queue those up and relax.

turns.text: Enjoy the nostalgia! I hope you have a wonderfully relaxing evening. Any tennis plans for the weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! Yeah, hopefully I can get on the court for some tennis tomorrow if the Portland rain holds off. Talk to you later!
